_tooltips.id: The calculation key of the source, e.g. order-total. Change it in the source.
_tooltips.name: The name key of the source, as people see it in lists.
_tooltips.description: The description key of the source.
_tooltips.source: The calculation as YAML: parameters, inputs, decision tables, functions, decisions, output and trigger. The Source tab has an editor and Validate.
_tooltips.definitionVersion: Moves on with every save that changes the source. Each run records the version it computed with. Set by the system.
_tooltips.outputEntity: The entity type the calculation writes its results into. Set by the system from the source.
_tooltips.releaseState: Whether the running application uses this calculation as it stands: NEW was never published, CHANGED differs from what was published, RELEASED is what triggers run. Set by the system.

tables.name: Name
tables.none: The calculation has no decision tables.
tables.unreadable: The source is not valid YAML; fix it on the Source tab first:
